```{r}
# Load blood DA table using MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionAnalysis API.
# epigen = FALSE avoids remote epigen pulls and matches filtering logic below.
blood_da_df <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionAnalysis::load_differential_analysis(
  selected_omes = "all",
  selected_tissues = "blood",
  single_matrix = TRUE,
  epigen = FALSE,
  combine_with_featgene = TRUE
)

blood_da_df
```

```{r}
# --- Timepoints: harmonize, order, and pretty labels (Figure 2 style) ---
tp_levels <- c(
  "during_20_min",
  "during_40_min",
  "post_10_min",
  "post_30_min",
  "post_3.5_hours",
  "post_24_hr"
)

tp_labels <- c(
  during_20_min  = "During 20 Min",
  during_40_min  = "During 40 Min",
  post_10_min    = "Post 10 Min",
  post_30_min    = "Post 30 Min",
  post_3.5_hours = "Post 3.5 Hour",
  post_24_hr     = "Post 24 Hour"
)

blood_da_df <- blood_da_df %>% 
  # Drop pre-exercise and unwanted assays
  filter(
    Timepoint != "pre_exercise",
    !assay %in% c("epigen-methylcap-seq", "epigen-atac-seq")
  ) %>% 
  # Normalize legacy timepoint names into canonical keys used in tp_levels
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(
      Timepoint,
      "post_15_30_45_min" = "post_30_min",
      "Post_30 min"       = "post_30_min",
      "post_3.5_4_hr"     = "post_3.5_hours",
      "Post_3.5 hours"    = "post_3.5_hours"
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = tp_levels)
  ) %>% 
  droplevels() %>%
  # Assay display names & facet order
  mutate(
    assay = recode(
      assay,
      "metab"               = "Metabolites",
      "prot-ol"             = "Proteins",
      "transcript-rna-seq"  = "Transcripts"
    ),
    assay = factor(assay, levels = c("Transcripts", "Proteins", "Metabolites"))
  )

# Colors for assays (from MotrpacHumanPreSuspension)
assay_colors <- c(
  "Metabolites" = unname(MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_OME_COLORS["Metabolomics"]),
  "Proteins"    = unname(MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_OME_COLORS["Proteomics"]),
  "Transcripts" = unname(MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_OME_COLORS["Transcriptomics"])
)

# Ready-to-add axis scale & theme for clean x labels
x_axis_ready <- scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = tp_labels)
x_axis_theme <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 6)),
  strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
)

# --- Usage in your plot ---
# p + x_axis_ready + x_axis_theme

```

```{r}
# 1) your per‐assay counts

         contrast_category %in% c("EE-CON","RE-CON")) %>%
  group_by(assay) %>%
  summarise(total_changed = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 2) now sum across assays to get the grand totals

  #group_by(contrast_category) %>%
  summarise(overall_changed = sum(total_changed), .groups = "drop")

# 3) view
total_changes
```

Helper function for sum up down
```{r}
make_logfc_summary <- function(data,
                               contrasts,
                               id_col  = NULL,
                               p_col   = "adj_p_value",
                               alpha   = 0.05) {
  
  tp_order <- levels(data$Timepoint)          # preserve factor order
  
  data %>% 
    filter(
      contrast_category %in% contrasts,       # chosen contrasts
      .data[[p_col]] < alpha                  # **only significant rows**
    ) %>% 
    group_by(contrast_category, assay, Timepoint) %>% 
    summarise(
      n_up   = if (is.null(id_col))
                 sum(logFC >  0, na.rm = TRUE)
               else
                 n_distinct(.data[[id_col]][logFC >  0]),
      n_down = if (is.null(id_col))
                 sum(logFC <  0, na.rm = TRUE)
               else
                 n_distinct(.data[[id_col]][logFC <  0]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      c(n_down, n_up),
      names_to  = "direction",
      values_to = "feature_count"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      feature_count = if_else(direction == "n_down",
                              -feature_count,   # make “down” negative
                               feature_count),
      direction     = if_else(direction == "n_up", "up", "down"),
      Timepoint     = factor(Timepoint,
                             levels = tp_order,
                             ordered = TRUE)
    )
}



```


```{r, fig.width=9,fig.height=7}
keep_contrasts <- c("EE-CON", "RE-CON", "CON-CON")

sum_df <- make_logfc_summary(blood_da_df, contrasts = keep_contrasts) %>% 
  mutate(contrast_category = str_remove(contrast_category, "-.*"))  # EE-EE → EE

ggplot(sum_df, aes(Timepoint, feature_count, fill = assay)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(assay ~ contrast_category, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = assay_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = tp_labels) +  # <- new labels here
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
  labs(
    x    = "Timepoint",
    y    = TeX("Sum of log$_2$FC features below FDR < 0.05"),
    fill = "Assay"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    legend.position    = "none"  # Remove the legend as it's redundant with facets
  )

ggsave(
  "blood_DA_feature_counts_EE_RE_CON.png",
   dpi = 320,
)

```

```{r}
keep_contrasts <- c("EE-CON", "RE-CON")

sum_df <- make_logfc_summary(blood_da_df, contrasts = keep_contrasts) %>% 
  mutate(
    contrast_category = str_remove(contrast_category, "-.*"),   # "EE-EE" → "EE"
    pattern_flag      = if_else(feature_count < 0, "stripe", "none")  # negative = hatched
  )

sum_df <- make_logfc_summary(blood_da_df, contrasts = c("EE-CON","RE-CON")) %>% 
  mutate(
    contrast_category = str_remove(contrast_category, "-.*"),
    pattern_flag      = if_else(feature_count < 0, "stripe", "none")  # NEG -> stripe, POS -> none
  )

p <- ggplot(sum_df, aes(Timepoint, feature_count)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, color = "black") +
  ggpattern::geom_col_pattern(
    aes(
      fill           = assay,
      pattern        = pattern_flag,              # <- mapped (no fixed pattern param!)
      pattern_fill   = after_scale(alpha(fill, 0.40))  # stripes use same color family
    ),
    width = 0.72,
    color = NA,
    pattern_angle    = 45,
    pattern_spacing  = 0.05,
    pattern_size     = 0.7,
    pattern_density  = 0.35,
    pattern_key_scale_factor = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(assay ~ contrast_category, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = assay_colors) +
  scale_pattern_manual(values = c(none = "none", stripe = "stripe"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = function(x) c(min(0, x[1]), max(0, x[2])),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = tp_labels) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Differentially abundant features") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA)
  )

p
```

# Combined
```{r}
# First, define your function to combine timepoints by assay
make_logfc_summary_by_assay_combined_contrasts <- function(data,
                                                          contrasts,
                                                          id_col = NULL,
                                                          p_col = "adj_p_value",
                                                          alpha = 0.05) {
  
  data %>% 
    filter(
      contrast_category %in% contrasts,       # chosen contrasts
      .data[[p_col]] < alpha                  # only significant rows
    ) %>% 
    # Apply the string removal transformation here
    mutate(
      contrast_category = str_remove(contrast_category, "-.*")  # "EE-CON" → "EE"
    ) %>%
    # Now group by the simplified contrast and assay
    group_by(contrast_category, assay) %>%    
    summarise(
      n_up   = if (is.null(id_col))
                 sum(logFC >  0, na.rm = TRUE)
               else
                 n_distinct(.data[[id_col]][logFC >  0]),
      n_down = if (is.null(id_col))
                 sum(logFC <  0, na.rm = TRUE)
               else
                 n_distinct(.data[[id_col]][logFC <  0]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      c(n_down, n_up),
      names_to  = "direction",
      values_to = "feature_count"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      Timepoint = "All Timepoints",  # Add this line to explicitly label as combined
      feature_count = if_else(direction == "n_down",
                              -feature_count,   # make "down" negative
                               feature_count),
      direction     = if_else(direction == "n_up", "up", "down")
    )
}
```

```{r}
# contrasts you care about
keep_contrasts <- c("EE-CON", "RE-CON")

# Apply the function that combines timepoints and merges contrasts
make_logfc_summary_by_assay_combined_contrasts(blood_da_df, contrasts = keep_contrasts)
```

```{r}
make_logfc_summary_summed_contrasts <- function(data,
                                               contrasts,
                                               id_col = NULL,
                                               p_col = "adj_p_value",
                                               alpha = 0.05,
                                               combined_name = "Combined RE and EE -Control") {
  
  data %>% 
    filter(
      contrast_category %in% contrasts,       # chosen contrasts
      .data[[p_col]] < alpha                  # only significant rows
    ) %>% 
    # Replace all contrast names with a single label
    mutate(
      contrast_category = combined_name  # Combine all contrasts under one name
    ) %>%
    # Group by the common contrast name and assay
    group_by(contrast_category, assay) %>%    
    summarise(
      n_up   = if (is.null(id_col))
                 sum(logFC >  0, na.rm = TRUE)
               else
                 n_distinct(.data[[id_col]][logFC >  0]),
      n_down = if (is.null(id_col))
                 sum(logFC <  0, na.rm = TRUE)
               else
                 n_distinct(.data[[id_col]][logFC <  0]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      c(n_down, n_up),
      names_to  = "direction",
      values_to = "feature_count"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      Timepoint = "All Timepoints",  # Add this line to explicitly label as combined
      feature_count = if_else(direction == "n_down",
                              -feature_count,   # make "down" negative
                               feature_count),
      direction     = if_else(direction == "n_up", "up", "down")
    )
}
```

```{r}
make_logfc_summary_absolute_counts <- function(data,
                                              contrasts,
                                              id_col = NULL,
                                              p_col = "adj_p_value",
                                              alpha = 0.05,
                                              combined_name = "Combined RE and EE-Control") {
  
  data %>% 
    filter(
      contrast_category %in% contrasts,       # chosen contrasts
      .data[[p_col]] < alpha                  # only significant rows
    ) %>% 
    # Replace all contrast names with a single label
    mutate(
      contrast_category = combined_name  # Combine all contrasts under one name
    ) %>%
    # Group by the common contrast name and assay
    group_by(contrast_category, assay) %>%    
    summarise(
      total_changed = if (is.null(id_col))
                        sum(logFC != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
                      else
                        n_distinct(.data[[id_col]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      Timepoint = "All Timepoints"  # Add this line to explicitly label as combined
    )
}
```

```{r}
make_logfc_summary_total_count <- function(data,
                                          contrasts,
                                          id_col = NULL,
                                          p_col = "adj_p_value",
                                          alpha = 0.05,
                                          combined_name = "Combined RE and EE-Control") {
  
  # First, get counts by assay
  by_assay <- data %>% 
    filter(
      contrast_category %in% contrasts,       # chosen contrasts
      .data[[p_col]] < alpha                  # only significant rows
    ) %>% 
    # Replace all contrast names with a single label
    mutate(
      contrast_category = combined_name  # Combine all contrasts under one name
    ) %>%
    # Group by the common contrast name and assay
    group_by(contrast_category, assay) %>%    
    summarise(
      total_changed = if (is.null(id_col))
                        sum(logFC != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
                      else
                        n_distinct(.data[[id_col]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      Timepoint = "All Timepoints"  # Add this line to explicitly label as combined
    )
  
  # Add a row with the grand total across all assays
  by_assay %>%
    bind_rows(
      by_assay %>%
        group_by(contrast_category, Timepoint) %>%
        summarise(
          total_changed = sum(total_changed),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          assay = "All Assays Combined"
        )
    )
}

get_total_changing_features <- function(data,
                                       contrasts,
                                       id_col = NULL,
                                       p_col = "adj_p_value",
                                       alpha = 0.05) {
  
  data %>% 
    filter(
      contrast_category %in% contrasts,       # chosen contrasts
      .data[[p_col]] < alpha                  # only significant rows
    ) %>% 
    summarise(
      total_changed = if (is.null(id_col))
                        sum(logFC != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
                      else
                        n_distinct(.data[[id_col]])
    ) %>%
    pull(total_changed)
}

# Get just the single total number
get_total_changing_features(blood_da_df, contrasts = keep_contrasts)
```
